title:
Buttercloth Seasonal Campaign
Email & Social Design
description:
A seasonal ecommerce campaign system created for Buttercloth across email and social media. The work included Presidents' Day and Valentine's Day promotions, product focused layouts, campaign graphics, image retouching, and channel specific adaptations designed to support a clear and consistent shopping experience.

The system brought product photography, promotional messaging, and calls to action into a cohesive visual structure that could be applied across different campaign themes and customer touchpoints.
concept: The design approach balances Buttercloth's polished apparel photography with simple typography, controlled spacing, and flexible promotional layouts. A consistent hierarchy allows each campaign to shift in color and tone while preserving the same recognizable structure across email, Instagram, and ecommerce placements.
